intro: Nuthanamaina Krupa is the latest Telugu Christian song from the album, Nityathejuda Yesayya (Vol-34) released by Hosanna Ministries featuring Senior Pastor, Singer, song-writer, Pastor John Wesley and music arranged by renowned christian music director, Pranam Kamlakhar. This song video was released on March 07, 2024 through Hosanna Ministries YouTube channel.
